title: observability: token-level cost/latency dashboards and alert refinements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Customers and SRE have been asking for better token-level visibility to understand per-token cost and per-stage latency for inference requests (prompt tokenize, model compute, kv-cache lookup, postprocess). Motivation: this improves root-cause analysis for regressions, helps Optimize recommend quantization/ batching changes with concrete unit economics, and reduces incident MTTD by surfacing stage-level hotspots. What this PR does: 1) Metrics: add token_cost_total, token_cost_per_request, token_stage_latency_histogram (labels: model, region, route, stage, cache_hit), and token_count gauge. 2) Tracing/logging: attach token_count, cache_hit, quantization_profile to request spans and structured logs emitted from runtime/handler. 3) KV cache metrics: emit kv_token_hits and kv_token_misses and provide derived hit_ratio panels. 4) Dashboards: update Grafana dashboard JSONs with templating by model and region; new panels for token cost breakdown, per-stage P50/P95/P99 latency, and KV hit ratio heatmap. 5) Alerts: tune SLO-based alerts to use token-adjusted thresholds (alert if p95 stage latency * token_count contributes > 80% of cost SLO) and add suppress/dedupe rules to avoid alert storms during rollout. 6) Rollout & feature flag: controlled behind feature flag redwood.feature.observability_token_breakdown (default off) with a documented migration path. Checklist: - [x] Metrics instrumentation added and unit tested - [x] Tracing/logging fields added and validated in local traces - [x] Dashboard JSON reviewed (Grafana panel refs) - [x] Alert rules reviewed with SRE and tested in staging - [x] Backwards-compatible (default flag OFF) - [x] Docs updated: docs/observability/token-metrics.md Testing notes: unit tests for metric labels and histogram buckets included; integration smoke test in CI verifies token-level metrics appear for a synthetic workload; staging rollout validated with controlled traffic and SRE drill. Related: ENG-4213 (token-level observability epic), ENG-4378 (kv cache telemetry). Deployment notes: apply dashboards via grafana-sync job, alert rule changes deploy via alertmanager config update. Impact: no breaking changes when flag is off; small extra telemetry tag cardinality when enabled (mitigated by templating and low-cardinality labels). Links: design doc https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-4213/token-level-observability and staging dashboard link (internal) TODO: follow-up to add per-embedding token cost when embeddings path is instrumented.
commits: Add token-level cost metrics and labels
Attach token_count and cache_hit tags to traces and logs
Grafana: add token cost and KV panels + templating
Alerts: add token-adjusted SLO rules and dedupe config
Docs: document token metrics and rollout steps
